title: 第2297章 中术第2296章 花中取法
slug: 八岁开始模拟的我觉醒重瞳
lines: 【振山元灵也很好奇，为何你会突然消失在花谷，后又直接出现在峡谷之外。但它还是感觉到，眼前好似有什么东西发生了变化，它总觉得你要找的东西已经不在前方，即便穿过谷道，或也见不到花谷。
而振山的话也让你在此刻怔住，因为在它的话中，这么长时间也才过去了一瞬。也就是说，你回来的时间点依旧是自己消失的一刻……能够让时间停顿的人没什么了不起，你自己也可以做到。但视七十万年如一瞬，这却不是能够轻松做到的。
如果不是什么人对你做的事情，换做是某件宝物，那也是相当恐怖的一件事情。这种程度的宝物，直追当初恶主使用的虚饰魔宝……】
【第三百九十万零八千五百七十八年，你第二次穿过谷道，进入到了花谷。只是这一次便如振山不妙的直觉一般，在这里它再也寻不到千面藏花的痕迹。
也早在穿行谷底期间，振山便一五一十的将自己的感受告诉过你，只是你还是打算进入花谷寻一寻。这不是说你不信振山，而是连这种宝物都能出现，它未必就不能蒙蔽你与振山的直觉，从而让你们找不到它。所以，既然都已经到了花谷外面，不妨花个一年时间进去找找。】
【哪怕如现在这般没有找到，至少也能排除你们的一个选项，可以安心去其他地方寻觅。这比回头察觉不对，找了一圈后再返回花谷寻找要耗费的时间少得多。】
【第三百九十万零八千五百八十五年，振山能带给你的辅助已经不如初时那般大。那一次它能够依靠的，是印象中的花谷，以此为痕迹去寻找相似的地方。而现在，就只能完全凭借自己的直觉，这种直觉明显要弱的多。
但好在你已经和千面藏花有过见面与接触的机会，再有振山这种似真似幻的直觉，便已经足够你施展万衍千寻神能来精准定位。是以第二次仅仅耗费七年时间，用还要快过第一次的速度你来到了一处洞穴，在这里见到了有些变化，但并不大的千面藏花。】
【这洞穴内没有花朵，但异香依旧，不比花谷要弱多少。细细探查后你发现，这里的香气不是花朵传来，而是洞穴内的一处暗流溪边，长着数不尽的蘑菇。形状与颜色都各不相同的蘑菇，散发的香气浓郁程度还要高过于花朵。
你第一次进入花谷时就没有放过那额外的收获，挑挑选选将能用的都收走了。虽然说品级都不是很高，最好的七环造化道品的道药都仅有两株，但胜在数量足够多，且有相当一部分不是那么容易培育。在外界，哪怕是现在你大力培养的两处残缺合道之地，和三重天外天也是稀缺的宝物。
而这里，数量更多的蘑菇仍旧是不错的灵物。你一时兴起，便又想要上手全部收走，但手伸出去就要施展无量乾坤时，你突然看到了苍灵看向你的古怪表情。
那样子似乎在说，你都已经有那么多机缘与库存，为何总是能够表现出这样一副“节俭”的模样。】
【不过在看到你望向自己时，苍灵说的话不是这样。只听他的神魂传音传来。
“花与蘑菇会不会寓意着什么？我认为大哥还是先做正事比较好，事后拿到东西再取这些也不迟……”
苍灵的话一语惊醒梦中人，如果没有出现第一次的事情也就罢了。但明明有了例子在前，为什么你在见到这些蘑菇时还会与第一次一样，这手就忍不住想要去取……以你的自控力，虽然也会节俭的拿小便宜，但断不能在正事没有做完前就拆桥，遇到大事你向来都能分得清事情的轻重。
忽然，你眼角瞥到了自己肩膀一侧，在那里，不知什么时候沾上了一抹青色的荧光！
这荧光散发着一股与周围蘑菇相差不大的香味，但这却让你毛骨悚然，瞬间机警到了十二分。因为以你的性子，真要有东西接触到自己，不可能毫无所察。所以，你肩膀上的荧光不可能是偶然出现……一定是针对自己的物件。】
【“是什么时候的事情……自己此前被人带入那个不知名的地方，会不会也与这有关？”你心中的问题很多，但还是最先将这荧光从肩上打落，也好在这并不是沾了就弄不下来。
而也是打落了肩上的荧光后，再看那些蘑菇，你则有了完全不同的感觉，吸引力不再有之前那般大。这让你更加确定，自己是在不知什么时候中了他人的术。而能让现在的自己这般神不知鬼不觉的中招……或许道源宇宙你现在也没有探清。
你机警的再次向周围深度探查，还是没有什么发现后，这才将目光重新看回了千面藏花。
早在振山首次跟你说，万釜一时兴起才留下了这法，你就有些感觉古怪。只是人的性格本就千奇百怪，万釜说不得就是这样一个人，这才压着这种想法没去想。现在看来，真实情况可能并不是这样，当初的万釜未必没有中术。
这个判断倒是让你安心了不少，因为至少说明就算真的有这样一个人，或者是某件守护灵一样的宝物，你不激它便不会死于非命。杀性不高，也是你重新拾起要接触千面藏花念头的主因。
毕竟已经与之接触了数千年，现在已经快要能做到振山说的话，自也没有白费一场的道理……】
【大着胆子你再次靠近了千面藏花，然而出乎预料的是，这一次明明同样有上万次变化，可却很顺利。
“是错觉吗？总感觉这一次变化的速度有所减缓……”脑中闪过这样的念头，但你同时也意识到了什么，却不去深想。赶紧按照振山早就与你说过的话，将灵念顺着自己与千面藏花接触的手，便进入了里面
大有一种鱼入大海的古怪感，而在那一个全新的光怪世界中，你找到了振山所形容的物体，并用灵念与之接触。顿时，一段短暂的记忆涌起，而获得了想要之物的灵思，也快速向着来时的路返回……】
content_en:
[Zhenshan Yuanling is also curious as to why you suddenly disappeared in the Valley of Flowers and then appeared directly outside the canyon. But it still feels that something has changed in front of it. It always feels that what you are looking for is no longer in front of you. Even if you pass through the valley, you may not be able to see the flower valley.
And Zhenshan's words also make you stunned at this moment, because in his words, such a long time has only passed. In other words, the time you come back is still the moment you disappeared... There is nothing special about people who can stop time. You can do it yourself. But viewing 700,000 years as a blink of an eye is not something that can be done easily.
If it wasn't something someone did to you, but it was a treasure, it would be quite a terrifying thing. A treasure of this caliber is on par with the pretentious magic treasure used by the evil lord...]
[In the 39008578th year, you passed through the valley for the second time and entered the Valley of Flowers. It's just that this time, it's like a bad intuition that shakes the mountain. There is no trace of the Thousand-Faced Hidden Flower here.
As early as when you were walking through the valley bottom, Zhenshan told you exactly how he felt, but you still planned to enter the Valley of Flowers to look for it. This is not to say that you don’t believe in Zhenshan, but even if such a treasure can appear, it may not be able to blind you and Zhenshan’s intuition, thus preventing you from finding it. So, now that we are outside the Valley of Flowers, we might as well spend a year going in and searching. 】
[Even if you don't find it like now, at least one of your options will be eliminated, and you can look for it elsewhere with peace of mind. This is much less time-consuming than turning around and realizing something is wrong, searching for a circle and then returning to the Valley of Flowers to search. 】
[In the 3908th585th year, the assistance Zhenshan can bring you is no longer as great as it was at the beginning. What it could rely on that time was the impression of the Valley of Flowers, and use it as a trace to find similar places. But now, I can only rely entirely on my own intuition, which is obviously much weaker.
But fortunately, you have already had the opportunity to meet and interact with Qianmian Zanghua, and Zhenshan's intuition, which is both real and illusory, is enough for you to use Wanyan Qianxun's divine power to accurately locate it. So the second time only took seven years, and you came to a cave at a faster speed than the first time, where you saw some changes, but not a big Thousand-faced Hidden Flower. 】
[There are no flowers in this cave, but the fragrance is still there, not much weaker than the Valley of Flowers. After careful investigation, you find that the fragrance here is not coming from flowers, but from an undercurrent in the cave, where countless mushrooms grow. Mushrooms come in different shapes and colors, and their fragrance is even more intense than flowers.
When you first entered the Valley of Flowers, you didn't let go of the extra harvest. You picked and picked up everything you could use. Although the grades are not very high, and the best seven-ring creation Tao medicines only have two strains, the advantage is that they are large enough, and a considerable number of them are not so easy to cultivate. In the outside world, even the two incomplete Hedao Lands and the Three Heavens and Outer Heavens that you have vigorously cultivated are rare treasures.
But here, more mushrooms are still good spiritual objects. On a whim, you wanted to take them all away, but when you stretched out your hand to use the Infinite Universe, you suddenly saw the strange expression Cangling looked at you.
That seems to be saying, you already have so many opportunities and inventory, why can you always show such a "frugal" appearance. 】
[But that’s not what Cangling said when he saw you looking at him. Just listen to the voice transmission from his soul.
"Do the flowers and mushrooms mean anything? I think it's better for the eldest brother to get down to business first, and it's not too late to get these things after you get them..."
Cangling's words awakened the dreamer. It would have been fine if the first thing hadn't happened. But clearly there is an example in front of you, why is it that when you see these mushrooms, they are still the same as the first time, and you can't help but want to take them... With your self-control, although you will be frugal and take advantage of small things, you can never burn the bridge before the main thing is done. You have always been able to distinguish the importance of things when encountering big things.
Suddenly, you caught a glimpse of the side of your shoulder from the corner of your eye, where there was a touch of cyan fluorescence at some point!
This fluorescence exudes a fragrance that is not much different from the surrounding mushrooms, but it makes your hair stand on end and makes you instantly alert. Because with your temperament, if something really comes into contact with you, it's impossible for you to not notice it at all. Therefore, the fluorescence on your shoulder cannot appear by chance...it must be an object directed at you. 】
["When did it happen... I was taken to that unknown place before, is it related to this?" You have many questions in your mind, but you are the first to knock the fluorescent light off your shoulder. Fortunately, it is not impossible to get it off if it gets stuck.
And after knocking off the fluorescent light on your shoulders, you will have a completely different feeling when you look at those mushrooms, and the attraction is no longer as great as before. This makes you more certain that you have fallen into someone else's spell at some point. And what makes me so unaware of the attack... Maybe you haven't figured out the Daoyuan Universe yet.
You carefully probed the surrounding area again, but after still finding nothing, you turned your gaze back to the Thousand-faced Hidden Flower.
As early as Zhenshan first told you that Wan Fu left this method on a whim, you felt a little weird. It's just that people's personalities are all kinds of weird, and Wan Fu can't be said to be such a person, so he suppresses this thought and doesn't think about it. Now it seems that the real situation may not be like this, and the original Wan Ke may not have been without tricks.
This judgment makes you feel at ease, because at least it means that even if there is such a person, or a treasure like a guardian spirit, it will not die unless you provoke it. The low lethality is also the main reason why you have come back to the idea of ​​contacting the Thousand-faced Hidden Flower.
After all, I have been in contact with it for thousands of years, and now I am almost able to do what Zhenshan said, so there is no reason to waste it...]
[You boldly approached the Thousand-faced Hidden Flower again. However, unexpectedly, this time there were tens of thousands of changes, but it went smoothly.
"Is it an illusion? It feels like the speed of change has slowed down this time..." Such thoughts flashed through your mind, but you also realized something at the same time, but didn't think about it deeply. Hurry up and follow what Zhenshan has told you a long time ago, follow your hand that is in contact with the Thousand-faced Hidden Flower, and enter it with your spiritual thoughts.
There is a strange feeling like a fish entering the sea, and in that new strange world, you find the object described by Zhenshan and contact it with your spiritual mind. Suddenly, a short memory emerged, and Lingsi, who had obtained what he wanted, quickly returned to the way he came...]
title_en: Chapter 2297: Chinese Art Chapter 2296: Taking the Method from Flowers
